integrity: Exact distance-multiset formulas reduce same-side collisions to repeated cumulative landmark counts. These give the n-1 lower bound, an odd-order cross-side obstruction, two rigid even-order equality cases, and a one-singleton block classification at odd order.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for canonical half graphs rather than arbitrary chain graphs with repeated twin classes.
Finite exhaustive verification runs through n=9 and is corroborative only.
The 2021 follow-up was accessible through its journal abstract page rather than searchable PDF text.
A differently phrased or non-indexed half-graph result may exist.
title: Multiset dimension and all bases of half graphs
